knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A trolley or second person reduces the manual handling risk, and the hose is kept out of the walkway.
Clear, dry floors and suitable footwear are the controls the guidance describes.
The task stops, the design is reviewed, and the report is recorded.
The manual handling section says detailing involves repeated, sustained and awkward movement.

practicalCriteria: Completes a site check for a sample driveway, recording the surface, gradient, traffic and people nearby.
Moves a loaded kit on a trolley and routes a hose out of a simulated walkway.
Cleans a simulated spill as it happens and records the near miss from a simulated buffing task.
passRule: Site check complete, kit moved safely, walkway clear, and spill cleaned, observed by an assessor. A quiz pass is not a practical pass.
stopWorkCriteria: Heavy item dragged across a wet surface
Hose or cord left across a walkway
